title: Chinna
desc: Chinna, a gangster, changes his way of life after he falls in love with Gayatri. However, he ends up in jail after he kills a gang leader in order to save Gayatri.

title: Naan Than Bala
desc: Bala, a principled priest, forms an improbable friendship with Poochi, a contract killer. Despite their starkly contrasting lives, their bond deepens profoundly.

title: Gopura Dheepam
desc: Meena's father does not approve of her relationship with Balu. Hence, he decides to get her married to another man, but she lies to her father that she is pregnant with her lover's child.

title: Puthaiyal
desc: Madhu steals a treasure map during an archaeological expedition and sends it to a gang. However, Swapna intercepts the map and decides to find the treasure on her own.

title: Sivakaasi
desc: Muthappa is forced to leave his house at a young age for a crime that his older brother, Udayappa, committed. When he returns home, he learns about his brother's antics and decides to punish him.
